title: Treatise on the One-Handed Snap Shot
summary: Teaches the pistol snap shot from the hip and the eye-led aim that makes it quick and sure.

title: The Ranger's Handbook of Mounted Pistol Work
summary: Teaches drawing, aiming and dismounting with a pistol from the saddle, with qi to calm the mount.

title: Canon of Standing Duels
summary: Sets out the side-on stance, the pace count and the single decisive shot of a formal pistol duel.

title: Guide to Pistol and Cloak
summary: Teaches hiding the draw under a cloak and using the heavy cloth to guard, blind and cover the shot.

title: A Workbook of Pistol and Hanger
summary: Drills fighting with a pistol in one hand and a short hanger sword in the other.

title: Handbook of Stairwell and Corridor Fighting
summary: Teaches shooting round turns, along walls and down stairs where the foe cannot spread out.

title: Drill-Book of Pistols Aboard Ship
summary: Teaches holding the stance and the aim on a moving deck and repelling boarders with the pistol.

title: Primer on Fouled Barrels and Failed Locks
summary: Teaches the shooter to read and clear a fouled barrel, a dull flint and a weak spring.

title: A Treatise on Shooting in Rain and Fog
summary: Teaches keeping powder and pan dry, and aiming and moving when rain or fog hides the foe.
